questions.prompt: Which of these are Snow White's seven dwarfs?
questions.fact: The dwarfs only got names in Disney's 1937 film. In the Grimm fairy tale they have none.

questions.prompt: Which of these are poems rather than novels?
questions.fact: James Joyce's novel Ulysses borrows its shape from the Odyssey, the poem about the same hero.

questions.prompt: How far do you travel in an Ironman triathlon, in kilometres?
questions.fact: About 226 km: a 3.8 km swim, a 180 km bike ride and a full marathon.

questions.prompt: In what year did Leonardo da Vinci start painting the Mona Lisa?
questions.fact: Around 1503. He kept working on it for more than ten years and never handed it over.

questions.prompt: Who was the first person to reach the South Pole?
questions.hint: He was Norwegian, and he used dog sleds.
questions.fact: Roald Amundsen got there in December 1911, five weeks before Robert Falcon Scott.

questions.prompt: In which country is Machu Picchu?
questions.hint: The nearest big city is Cusco, once the capital of the Inca Empire.
questions.fact: Machu Picchu was built for an Inca emperor in the 1400s and was abandoned about a century later.
